lyrics:
[verse]
An elephant sat on the couch,
Bruno bumped it, ouch, ouch, ouch!
Kiki whispered, look, it's there,
A big problem, but no one dares!
[chorus]
Elephant in the room, elephant in the room,
Big old problem, but nobody speaks, ka-boom!
Elephant in the room, elephant in the room,
Talk it out and clear the gloom!
[verse]
It means a problem big and clear,
That everyone knows is sitting here,
But no one wants to say a word,
So talk about it, be heard!
[chorus]
Elephant in the room, elephant in the room,
Big old problem, but nobody speaks, ka-boom!
Elephant in the room, elephant in the room,
Say it now and lift the gloom!
[outro]
So when a problem fills the room,
Talk about it, clear the gloom!
